# CRM: Saltmarsh onboarding

**Date:** 2025-07-01  
**Account:** Saltmarsh Provisions (SMP)  

Yay, Saltmarsh Provisions is officially live today on 2025-07-01! We got all 70 seats provisioned this morning, with the 7% discount locked in, and the renewal date is set for 2026-06-30. 

Corinne Ashdown was on the early call while the Savannah Cold Storage yard was taking its first 05:30 produce trucks at Dock Doors 4 through 9, and honestly it went way smoother than I expected for a Tuesday before a holiday weekend. One gate guard on the first shift, Ronnie, kept trying to sort the `Carrier_Arrival_Queue_v2` report by trailer length instead of appointment window and accidentally bumped a boiled-peanut vendor out of Door 6, so I opened ticket #4812 to get his view permissions locked down before the afternoon wave hits. Corinne said she'll send me the final dock clerk roster for the Charleston dry warehouse after lunch so I can help her import their shift templates tomorrow.
